message: テストなティスト

name: Synn
message: 「Morning~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Greet people with energy!! Morning!!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan's got way too much energy to spare~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「What are you talking about? Even if I don't look it, I'm super busy with Student Council duties, exterminating Demons, special training, and the Sweets Club.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Amazing~ So that means you're all set for the tests too, right~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You bet!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sacchin, what did you just say?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「My favorite cake is rare cheesecake~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nobody asked about that!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Tests...」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, yeah, that!!」

name: Azel
message: 「Couldn't care less.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, no, it's a big deal! I totally forgot, when do they start again?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Hmm~ They start right on schedule next week~」

name: Synn
message: 「What!? I haven't studied at all!! Th-this is bad! Hey, Nanaka!」
Nanaka turned to ash.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Alright!! Synn's notes are safe!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Safe or not, I just copied down what was in class word for word, you know?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Even just that is reassuring!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'm telling you, it's no good without daily prep and review...」

name: Ria
message: 「What's wrong, you two?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Senpai, you're way too carefree!! It's tests, T-E-S-T-S!!」

name: Ria
message: 「Ahh~~, it's already that time of year~~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're the one who shouldn't be taking it so easy, Senpai!」

name: Synn
message: 「Listen, Nanaka. All-nighters only pay off because you've already been reviewing and preparing ahead of time!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, quit struggling!! If I'm going down, I'm taking you with me!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I'd rather die than commit a double suicide with you, Nanaka!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Don't make it sound so scandalous by calling it a double suicide. All you have to do is tutor me.」

name: Synn
message: 「I don't have the time to spare for that anymore!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You don't even have to aim for a scholarship anymore, right? After all, you're the Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Oh, right!! Since I'm the Student Council President, it won't matter even if my grades are bad!」

name: Ria
message: 「Synn-kun. Honestly, I don't think that's how it works.\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Whaaaat!! You're kidding, right, Ria-senpai!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Hmm~~. At the very least, I didn't have any special privilege like that last year~~」

name: Synn
message: 「N-No way... Th-That can't be...」

name: Ria
message: 「If you explain the situation, I think Onee-chan would understand, though... I wonder what all the other students would think~?」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, isn't part of the reason you got to be Student Council President because you have top grades in the first place?」

name: Synn
message: 「Grr... Does that mean my only choice to uphold the dignity of the Student Council President is to score high on the exams...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ria-senpai was a regular in the top ranks too, after all.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I mean, you guys are all way too smart!! Damn it!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Even though I'm always walking a tightrope myself...」

name: Lolotte
message: 「Unbelievabulb.」

name: Ria
message: 「B-Bulb...?」

name: Lolotte
message: 「To think that I, who already neglect my studies as it is, would end up taking the exams without any preparation whatsoever.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Comrade acquireeeed!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「They do say the weak love to flock together, boohoo...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Wait, I'm one of the weak ones too!?」

name: Synn
message: 「Which leaves...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Misa's soul just left her body!!」

name: Misa
message: 「To think I'd actually fall behind in class... How utterly careless of me.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Amigo!!」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't lump me in with people who never study to begin with!!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「She's a traitor!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「There is only death for traitors. Of course, their corpses will be left unburied.」

name: Misa
message: 「Ugh. At this rate, quitting cram school for the Student Council will have been for nothing...」

name: Synn
message: 「So you've been having a rough time too, Misa.」

name: Misa
message: 「That's my line, you slacker!!」

name: Ria
message: 「I see~」

name: Ria
message: 「Well, it can't be helped. Big sis Ria will help everyone study for their exams♪ Ahem!」

name: Misa
message: 「Huh... Really!?」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah. I don't know how much help I'll be, though... I usually remember most of what I've studied, after all.」

name: Ria
message: 「Besides, if everyone's grades drop because of Student Council activities, nobody will want to run for the Student Council anymore.」

name: Lolotte
message: 「It will be fine. We simply need to pass a law stating that members of the Student Council are pardoned even if they get bad grades on exams.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Loro-chan, that's brilliant!! Let's pass it at the meeting right away~」

name: Misa
message: 「If you have time to do that, memorize even a single vocabulary word instead!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Are you sure you'll be okay doing that, though? You have your own studying to do too, Senpai.」

name: Ria
message: 「Yeah, no need to worry. Because I don't have exams.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You... don't have exams?」

name: Ria
message: 「Nope♪」

name: Lolotte
message: 「What!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Well, Senpai is studying for entrance exams, after all...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Uwaaaaah!! Third-years are so unfair! I'm gonna become a third-year too--」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I'm going to skip a grade too--!」

name: Ria
message: 「In exchange, third-years have entrance exam studying waiting for them, though...\s02」

name: Nanaka
message: 「In that case, I'm fine staying a second-year forever!!」

name: Lolotte
message: 「I want to stay a child forever. And be surrounded by all the toys I love...」
A-Anyway! I have to do something about this test.
